map.string: 6|7 World Studio accessibility profile (interface palette preset, text scale, keyboard focus, reduce motion, custom colours, scene colour filter), as sw67::a11y::serialize writes it. Edited in the Accessibility floater; every 6|7 module reads it through SW67Accessibility.
When off (the default), the scene colour filter (RenderCVDMode) is left out of snapshots, so exported images keep their true colours. Set from the 6|7 Accessibility floater.
Base URL of the King Jahmir gateway (services/king-jahmir), for example https://kj.example.com. Empty: King Jahmir shows that he is not set up. Must be https except for 127.0.0.1 and localhost.
Show King Jahmir's crown bubble after login.
King Jahmir conversation text size: 0 small, 1 normal, 2 medium, 3 large, 4 huge.
King Jahmir: send the name of the window in front, and its feature, with each message (Use this screen for help). Off by default.
King Jahmir: let the gateway read your own Avatar Life records when you ask (Live account help). Off by default.
King Jahmir: let him propose saving preferences across conversations (Remember my preferences). Nothing is saved without your confirmation. Off by default.
Set once King Jahmir's crown bubble has been placed clear of the viewer's controls; after that it stays where the user drags it.
